tool_args.rationale: The epidemic-mobility and flux-conservation signatures map to the inland-hub siphon, while the pilot saturates with input. A varying-gradient open-branch probe resolves the principal remaining ambiguity before fitting.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the bridge-mapped two-layer siphon immediately
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: All pilot rows have the same sink gradient, so sink inhibition and branch contributions are not identifiable across gradients.
The epidemic mobility bridge and saturating pilot point to a static siphon; a coupled memory trajectory is not yet the leading ambiguity.
These remain competing stationary mechanisms, but also require gradient variation to distinguish.
